components.text: The Water Sigil is a rather simple sigil. When you right-click while looking at a block, you can drain $(blood)100 LP$() from your Soul Network to place a source block of water in the world. If there's not enough LP, it will instead drain the toll from your health. Crafted via the Alchemy Table and an Alchemy Array.
It can also be used in the Alchemy Table to automate the production of $(water)Water Buckets$(). The Sigil is not consumed in this recipe.
